_meta.purpose: Facility register for strategic disposition routing. Replaces the hardcoded FACILITIES / MECHANICAL_RECYCLERS lists that used to live in services/facility_service.py.
_meta.coordinates_policy: Coordinates are NEVER invented or inferred. An entry either carries a coordinate that already existed in this repository (with the source named in coordinates_source) or carries null and coordinates_source "TODO". A facility with null coordinates is excluded from distance routing and reported back in the API response under facilities_excluded, so it is visibly missing rather than silently absent.
_meta.district_policy: The district field is standard Sri Lankan administrative geography, not data taken from this repository. It is descriptive only -- nothing in the routing reads it. Spot-check before publication.
_meta.status_policy: operational = the cited source describes the plant as operating. unconfirmed = this repository carries no verifiable source URL for the entry, or the source does not confirm current operation. An unconfirmed facility may be offered as an alternative but is never returned as the recommendation.
_meta.tariff_policy: tariff_lkr_per_kwh is null unless a tariff is stated by a source cited here. A null tariff suppresses the indicative electricity value AND the grid CO2-avoided figure for that facility.
